articles.author: Emily Burack
articles.title: Prince Harry Reacts to Meta Settlement: “Change Cannot Wait” - Town & Country Magazine
articles.description: He called the $567 million fine “accountability” for the big tech company.
articles.content:
Prince Harry is praising a federal judges decision ordering Meta to pay a fine of $567 million for failing to warn the public about the dangers its platforms pose to children.
